import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from pathlib import Path
from scipy import stats

from sklearn.dummy import DummyRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Ridge
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import TimeSeriesSplit, GridSearchCV, train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="notebook")
RANDOM_STATE = 42

# Change to Path("data") if running from the project root
DATA_DIR = Path("../data")

files = sorted(DATA_DIR.glob("gt_*.csv"))

if not files:
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"No gt_*.csv files found in {DATA_DIR.resolve()}"
    )

frames = []

for file in files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file)
    df["Year"] = int(file.stem.split("_")[-1])
    frames.append(df)

data = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

feature_cols = [
    "AT", "AP", "AH", "AFDP",
    "GTEP", "TIT", "TAT", "CDP"
]

target_cols = ["TEY", "CO", "NOX"]

print("Dataset shape:", data.shape)
print("Years:", sorted(data["Year"].unique()))
print("Features:", feature_cols)
print("Targets:", target_cols)

display(data.head())

# ============================================================
# TUNE RIDGE SEPARATELY FOR EACH TARGET
# ============================================================

ridge_models = {}
ridge_cv_results = {}

for target in target_cols:
    pipeline = Pipeline([
        ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
        ("model", Ridge())
    ])

    search = GridSearchCV(
        estimator=pipeline,
        param_grid={"model__alpha": alpha_grid["model__alpha"]},
        scoring="neg_root_mean_squared_error",
        cv=tscv,
        n_jobs=-1,
        refit=True
    )

    search.fit(X_train, Y_train[target])

    ridge_models[target] = search.best_estimator_
    ridge_cv_results[target] = {
        "Best_Alpha": search.best_params_["model__alpha"],
        "CV_RMSE": -search.best_score_
    }

display(pd.DataFrame(ridge_cv_results).T)

# ============================================================
# FIT BASELINE MODELS
# ============================================================

models = {
    "Mean Predictor": {},
    "Linear Regression": {},
    "Ridge Regression": ridge_models
}

for target in target_cols:
    # Baseline 1: mean prediction
    mean_model = DummyRegressor(strategy="mean")
    mean_model.fit(X_train, Y_train[target])

    # Baseline 2: ordinary least squares
    linear_model = LinearRegression()
    linear_model.fit(X_train, Y_train[target])

    models["Mean Predictor"][target] = mean_model
    models["Linear Regression"][target] = linear_model

print("All baseline models trained.")

# ============================================================
# IMPORTS AND CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans, DBSCAN
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

RANDOM_STATE = 42
DATA_DIR = "../data"
OUTPUT_DIR = "../outputs/unsupervised"

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "plots"), exist_ok=True)

print("Output directory:", os.path.abspath(OUTPUT_DIR))

# ============================================================
# K-MEANS MODEL SELECTION
# ============================================================

kmeans_rows = []

for k in range(2, 11):
    model = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=RANDOM_STATE, n_init=10)
    labels = model.fit_predict(X_dev_scaled)
    sizes = pd.Series(labels).value_counts()

    score = silhouette_score(
        X_dev_scaled, labels,
        sample_size=min(5000, len(X_dev_scaled)),
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    kmeans_rows.append({
        "K": k,
        "Inertia": model.inertia_,
        "Silhouette Score": score,
        "Minimum Cluster Size": int(sizes.min()),
        "Maximum Cluster Size": int(sizes.max())
    })

kmeans_search = pd.DataFrame(kmeans_rows)
display(kmeans_search)
kmeans_search.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "kmeans_silhouette_results.csv"), index=False)

# ============================================================
# FINAL K-MEANS MODEL
# ============================================================

# Review Sections 6–7 before finalizing this candidate value.
SELECTED_K = 4

kmeans_model = KMeans(
    n_clusters=SELECTED_K,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    n_init=10
)
kmeans_labels_dev = kmeans_model.fit_predict(X_dev_scaled)
kmeans_labels_2015 = kmeans_model.predict(X_2015_scaled)

development_data["KMeans_Cluster"] = kmeans_labels_dev
comparison_data["KMeans_Cluster"] = kmeans_labels_2015

display(development_data["KMeans_Cluster"].value_counts().sort_index().to_frame("count"))
display(comparison_data["KMeans_Cluster"].value_counts().sort_index().to_frame("count"))

# ============================================================
# DBSCAN PARAMETER SEARCH
# ============================================================

def stratified_dbscan_silhouette(X, labels, max_samples=3000, random_state=42):
    labels = np.asarray(labels)
    keep = labels != -1
    X_non_noise = X[keep]
    y_non_noise = labels[keep]

    cluster_ids, counts = np.unique(y_non_noise, return_counts=True)
    valid_clusters = cluster_ids[counts >= 2]
    if len(valid_clusters) < 2:
        return np.nan, 0

    valid = np.isin(y_non_noise, valid_clusters)
    X_valid = X_non_noise[valid]
    y_valid = y_non_noise[valid]

    rng = np.random.default_rng(random_state)
    budget = min(max_samples, len(y_valid))
    chosen = []

    for cluster in valid_clusters:
        idx = np.flatnonzero(y_valid == cluster)
        chosen.extend(rng.choice(idx, size=2, replace=False).tolist())

    remaining_budget = max(0, budget - len(chosen))
    remaining = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(len(y_valid)), np.asarray(chosen, dtype=int))

    if remaining_budget > 0 and len(remaining) > 0:
        extra = rng.choice(
            remaining,
            size=min(remaining_budget, len(remaining)),
            replace=False
        )
        chosen.extend(extra.tolist())

    chosen = np.asarray(chosen, dtype=int)
    X_sample = X_valid[chosen]
    y_sample = y_valid[chosen]

    n_labels = len(np.unique(y_sample))
    if n_labels < 2 or n_labels >= len(y_sample):
        return np.nan, len(y_sample)

    return silhouette_score(X_sample, y_sample), len(y_sample)


eps_values = [0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0, 1.2, 1.5, 2.0]
min_samples_values = [5, 10, 15, 20]
dbscan_rows = []

for eps in eps_values:
    for min_samples in min_samples_values:
        model = DBSCAN(eps=eps, min_samples=min_samples)
        labels = model.fit_predict(X_dev_scaled)

        non_noise = labels != -1
        cluster_labels = labels[non_noise]
        sizes = pd.Series(cluster_labels).value_counts()

        score, score_n = stratified_dbscan_silhouette(
            X_dev_scaled, labels,
            max_samples=3000,
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE
        )

        dbscan_rows.append({
            "eps": eps,
            "min_samples": min_samples,
            "Number of Clusters": len(set(labels) - {-1}),
            "Noise Count": int((labels == -1).sum()),
            "Noise Percentage": 100 * float((labels == -1).mean()),
            "Silhouette Score": score,
            "Silhouette Sample Size": score_n,
            "Minimum Cluster Size": int(sizes.min()) if len(sizes) else 0,
            "Maximum Cluster Size": int(sizes.max()) if len(sizes) else 0
        })

dbscan_search = pd.DataFrame(dbscan_rows)
display(dbscan_search.sort_values("Silhouette Score", ascending=False, na_position="last"))
dbscan_search.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "dbscan_parameter_search.csv"), index=False)

# ============================================================
# FINAL DBSCAN MODEL
# ============================================================

# Inspect the parameter-search table before choosing final values.
SELECTED_EPS = 1.0
SELECTED_MIN_SAMPLES = 10

dbscan_model = DBSCAN(eps=SELECTED_EPS, min_samples=SELECTED_MIN_SAMPLES)
dbscan_labels_dev = dbscan_model.fit_predict(X_dev_scaled)
development_data["DBSCAN_Cluster"] = dbscan_labels_dev

n_dbscan_clusters = len(set(dbscan_labels_dev) - {-1})
noise_percentage = 100 * np.mean(dbscan_labels_dev == -1)

print("Number of clusters:", n_dbscan_clusters)
print("Noise percentage:", round(noise_percentage, 2), "%")
display(development_data["DBSCAN_Cluster"].value_counts().sort_index().to_frame("count"))

dbscan_non_noise = development_data[development_data["DBSCAN_Cluster"] != -1].copy()

dbscan_feature_profiles = dbscan_non_noise.groupby("DBSCAN_Cluster")[feature_cols].agg(
    ["count", "mean", "median", "std", "min", "max"]
)
dbscan_target_profiles = dbscan_non_noise.groupby("DBSCAN_Cluster")[target_cols].agg(
    ["count", "mean", "median", "std", "min", "max"]
)

display(dbscan_feature_profiles)
display(dbscan_target_profiles)

dbscan_feature_profiles.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "dbscan_feature_profiles.csv"))
dbscan_target_profiles.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "dbscan_cluster_profiles.csv"))

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor, GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

RANDOM_STATE = 42
MAX_TUNING_SAMPLES = 6000

    PROJECT_DIR = PROJECT_DIR.parent

OUTPUT_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "outputs" / "nox_svr"

# ============================================================

# ============================================================

fit_data = train_data[train_data["Year"] <= 2013].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
validation_data = train_data[train_data["Year"] == 2014].copy().reset_index(drop=True)

def evenly_spaced_sample(frame, max_samples):
    if len(frame) <= max_samples:
        return frame.copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    positions = np.linspace(0, len(frame) - 1, max_samples, dtype=int)
    return frame.iloc[positions].copy().reset_index(drop=True)

tuning_data = evenly_spaced_sample(fit_data, MAX_TUNING_SAMPLES)
X_fit = tuning_data[feature_cols]
y_fit = tuning_data["NOX"]
X_validation = validation_data[feature_cols]
y_validation = validation_data["NOX"]

# ============================================================
# SVR PIPELINE AND SMALL PARAMETER GRID
# ============================================================

svr_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ("svr", SVR(kernel="rbf"))
])

param_grid = {
    "svr__C": [1, 10, 100],
    "svr__epsilon": [0.1, 0.5],
    "svr__gamma": ["scale", 0.01]
}
parameter_candidates = list(ParameterGrid(param_grid))
print("Number of parameter combinations:", len(parameter_candidates))

# ============================================================
# TUNE SVR USING 2014 VALIDATION
# ============================================================

search_rows = []
best_validation_rmse = np.inf
best_svr_params = None

for candidate_number, params in enumerate(parameter_candidates, start=1):
    candidate_model = Pipeline([
        ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
        ("svr", SVR(kernel="rbf", C=params["svr__C"],
                    epsilon=params["svr__epsilon"],
                    gamma=params["svr__gamma"]))
    ])
    candidate_model.fit(X_fit, y_fit)
    validation_prediction = candidate_model.predict(X_validation)
    validation_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_validation, validation_prediction))

    search_rows.append({
        **params,
        "Validation_RMSE": validation_rmse
    })

    if validation_rmse < best_validation_rmse:
        best_validation_rmse = validation_rmse
        best_svr_params = params.copy()

    print(f"Completed candidate {candidate_number}/{len(parameter_candidates)} | "
          f"Validation RMSE: {validation_rmse:.4f}")

search_results = pd.DataFrame(search_rows).sort_values("Validation_RMSE")
display(search_results)
search_results.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "nox_svr_validation_search_results.csv", index=False)

final_svr_data = evenly_spaced_sample(train_data, MAX_FINAL_SVR_SAMPLES)

y_final_svr = final_svr_data["NOX"]

                C=best_svr_params["svr__C"],
                epsilon=best_svr_params["svr__epsilon"],
                gamma=best_svr_params["svr__gamma"]))
])
best_svr.fit(X_final_svr, y_final_svr)

print("Best parameters:", best_svr_params)
print("Best 2014 validation RMSE:", best_validation_rmse)
print("Final SVR training observations:", len(X_final_svr))

# ============================================================

import warnings
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, PolynomialFeatures

# ============================================================
# INSPECT NOX DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

print(data["NOX"].describe())
print("Skewness:", data["NOX"].skew())
print("Kurtosis:", data["NOX"].kurtosis())

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

sns.histplot(data["NOX"], kde=True, ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set_title("Original NOX distribution")
axes[0].set_xlabel("NOX")

sns.histplot(np.log(data["NOX"]), kde=True, ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set_title("Log-transformed NOX distribution")
axes[1].set_xlabel("log(NOX)")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(OUTPUT_DIR / "nox_distribution_comparison.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()

# ============================================================
# FIT MODELS AND EVALUATE ON 2014 VALIDATION DATA
# ============================================================

validation_predictions = {}
validation_rows = []
fitted_validation_models = {}

for model_name, model in models.items():
    target_for_fit = np.log(y_fit) if model_name in log_target_models else y_fit

    model.fit(X_fit, target_for_fit)
    raw_prediction = model.predict(X_validation)

    y_prediction = (
        np.exp(raw_prediction)
        if model_name in log_target_models
        else raw_prediction
    )

    validation_predictions[model_name] = y_prediction
    fitted_validation_models[model_name] = model

    validation_rows.append({
        "Model": model_name,
        "MAE": mean_absolute_error(y_validation, y_prediction),
        "RMSE": np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_validation, y_prediction)),
        "R2": r2_score(y_validation, y_prediction)
    })

    print(f"Completed: {model_name}")

validation_results = pd.DataFrame(validation_rows).sort_values("RMSE")
display(validation_results.round(4))
validation_results.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "nox_validation_model_comparison_2014.csv", index=False)

# ============================================================
# RETRAIN SELECTED MODEL ON ALL 2011–2014 DATA
# ============================================================

final_model = models[best_model_name]

target_for_final_fit = (
    np.log(development_data["NOX"])
    if best_model_name in log_target_models
    else development_data["NOX"]
)

final_model.fit(development_data[feature_cols], target_for_final_fit)

# ============================================================
# EVALUATE SELECTED MODEL ON 2015 COMPARISON DATA
# ============================================================

X_comparison = comparison_data[feature_cols]
y_comparison = comparison_data["NOX"]

raw_comparison_prediction = final_model.predict(X_comparison)
comparison_prediction = (
    np.exp(raw_comparison_prediction)
    if best_model_name in log_target_models
    else raw_comparison_prediction
)

comparison_metrics = pd.DataFrame([{
    "Model": best_model_name,
    "MAE": mean_absolute_error(y_comparison, comparison_prediction),
    "RMSE": np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_comparison, comparison_prediction)),
    "R2": r2_score(y_comparison, comparison_prediction)
}])

display(comparison_metrics.round(4))
comparison_metrics.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "nox_selected_model_2015_metrics.csv", index=False)

import warnings
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from scipy.stats import ks_2samp
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
RANDOM_STATE = 42

PROJECT_DIR = Path.cwd()
if not (PROJECT_DIR / "data").exists() and (PROJECT_DIR.parent / "data").exists():
    PROJECT_DIR = PROJECT_DIR.parent

DATA_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "data"
OUTPUT_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "outputs" / "nox_residual_feature_shift"
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# FIT LINEAR REGRESSION AND GENERATE 2015 RESIDUALS
# ============================================================

development_data = data[data["Year"] <= 2014].copy()
comparison_data = data[data["Year"] == 2015].copy()

if development_data.empty or comparison_data.empty:
    raise ValueError("Required development years (2011–2014) or 2015 comparison data are missing.")

X_train = development_data[feature_cols]
y_train = development_data["NOX"]
X_test = comparison_data[feature_cols]
y_test = comparison_data["NOX"]

linear_model = LinearRegression()
linear_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_prediction = linear_model.predict(X_test)
residuals = y_test.to_numpy() - y_prediction

metrics = pd.DataFrame([{
    "Model": "Linear Regression",
    "MAE": mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_prediction),
    "RMSE": np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, y_prediction)),
    "R2": r2_score(y_test, y_prediction)
}])

display(metrics.round(4))
metrics.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "linear_regression_2015_residual_metrics.csv", index=False)

residual_data = comparison_data[["Year"] + feature_cols + ["NOX"]].copy()
residual_data["Predicted_NOX"] = y_prediction
residual_data["Residual"] = residuals
residual_data["Absolute_Error"] = np.abs(residuals)
residual_data["Error_Direction"] = np.where(
    residual_data["Residual"] >= 0,
    "Underprediction",
    "Overprediction"
)

residual_data.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "linear_regression_2015_residuals.csv", index=False)

feature_cols = ["AT", "AP", "AH", "AFDP", "GTEP", "TIT", "TAT", "CDP"]
target_cols = ["TEY", "CO", "NOX"]

    "n_estimators": [150, 200, 300],

}

    n_iter=4,
    scoring="neg_mean_absolute_error",

)
